listed_sector_signals.signal: Lists cement, iron and steel, pulp and paper, petrochemical, chemical, and glass as the target energy-intensive industries (several are registered continuous-flow sectors)
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Energy-intensive industries (EII) (cement, iron and steel, pulp and paper, petrochemical, 
chemical, aluminum, and glass) are large sectors playing significant roles in the 
development of any country.
listed_sector_signals.sector: cement; steel; pulp & paper; petrochemicals; glass

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Names aluminum as one of the energy-intensive industries of interest
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Energy-intensive industries (EII) (cement, iron and steel, pulp and paper, petrochemical, 
chemical, aluminum, and glass) are large sectors

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Discusses cogeneration (combined heat and power) as an option evaluated for the plant
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Energy cogeneration is a process that combines the generation of heat and electricity, 
which increases the utilization of the energy contained in the fuels used in this process.

one_line: The paper develops a generic ISO 50001-based conceptual map of stakeholders and functional areas for an energy management system in energy-intensive industries, naming sectors like cement, steel, pulp & paper, petrochemicals and glass only as examples without applying or validating anything in a continuous-production plant.
